Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at MicroMetrics is excited to pilot Redwood for our data-enrichment flows. We expect initial usage to be light (~$1.5–2k/mo) during the 90-day pilot.

Alex / team — Procurement can approve a temporary invoice-only admission for small pilots under specific conditions. Summary of required items for an exception: 

1) Maximum pilot cap clearly documented (requested here: $2,000/mo)
2) Completed vendor intake form (we have micrometrics-onboarding-form.pdf attached)
3) Proof of entity (EIN/W9 or equivalent)
4) Single-point billing contact and invoice address (must match legal entity)
5) A procurement-signed "temporary invoice-only" addendum that includes: start/end date, cap, and auto-escalation back to PO workflow at pilot end
6) Finance agreement on payment terms (net 30) and final sign-off on credit risk

If the above are satisfied we typically issue a short addendum and tag the vendor as 'pilot-invoice-only' in the vendor registry for 90 days. After 90 days, either Procurement will request a PO or Procurement will authorize continued invoicing only after a full vendor setup.

Attached: procurement-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (stub with required evidence fields). Evan — can you confirm who is the AP contact and whether MicroMetrics can provide a W9?

— Logan Wright

Team — Finance is okay with a conditional invoice-only path for this pilot under the following conditions: 

- Cap enforced at $2,000/month; any overage requires pre-approval from Redwood Finance
- Net 30 payment terms accepted; invoices to be sent to accounting@micrometrics.io with PO reference set to "TEMP-INVOICE-DEAL-4387"
- We require a completed W9 (or equivalent) and bank details for ACH. We will perform a standard credit check given the 90-day exposure
- Finance will place vendor on 'pilot watch' and will require a reconciliation at 45 days to confirm spend trajectory

Logan — can Procurement prepare the short addendum (template below) and have it countersigned? If procurement adds a clause that Redwood can stop service if invoices are past due >45 days, Finance is comfortable.

Template clause to include in addendum: "This temporary invoice-only admission is valid from <start> to <end>, capped at the monthly amount above. MicroMetrics agrees to provide W9 and bank details within 7 calendar days of signature. Redwood Inference reserves the right to suspend service if invoices are past due by more than 45 days."

— Priyom Das
